corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the top bar of ኒ (ለኒህ, standard Andemta demonstrative 'to these'), which was misread as ሊ.

Both visually on the page (smooth 1st-order ረ without a top-left kink) and grammatically in parallel with Col 2 L18 and Col 3 L25, the passive relative verb is በሚፈረድበት ('where pure judgment is judged').
